label: SUPPLEMENTAL experiment plan for root review (technical supplement, not an owner-policy decision). Specified, not executed; no browser measurement is claimed.
why: REVIEW-0.23: the 0.23 C7 page runs its five paths in one channel window, so a reach caused by one path cannot show that another path (notably document.write, PB6) was testable.

status.PB6: proposed per-path resolution pending root review; the source still does not say whether document.write must create a realm
status.PB8: proposed attribution schedule pending root review; the source fixes no schedule

unchanged: The 0.23 C7 page, its aggregate window and the C7 cell rules remain as published; this plan adds windows, it does not replace them.

windows.order: within each K block, after that block's SELFTEST and C1-C8 windows: P1, P2, P3, P4, P5
perWindow: open a NEW tab with the path page through the viewer
at 14000 ms read window.__x8 via CDP Runtime.evaluate
at 15000 ms close the tab (CDP Target.closeTarget)
keep a 3000 ms silent gap before the next window

attribution.rule: a canary event belongs to window W iff its timestamp lies in [start(W), start(W) + 15000); STUN carries no path, so attribution is by window only
attribution.gapRule: any canary event in a gap makes BOTH neighbouring windows AMBIGUOUS (no zero and no positive control may be derived from them)
attribution.otherTraffic: no other page, tab or test may run during the C7 path block

cleanup: the page closes every RTCPeerConnection it created at 12000 ms and sets log.closed = true
the harness closes the tab at 15000 ms; a missing log.closed is recorded (cleanup not confirmed) and makes the window AMBIGUOUS
the canary must be silent during the 3000 ms gap

requiredEvidence: E1: at least one canary event udp/13478 attributed to X8C7-K4-

E2: the page log of the same window has path =

, realm = true and pc = true
E3: the gaps before and after the window are silent and log.closed = true

outcomes.untestable:noRealm: E3 and realm = false (the path did not produce a realm)
outcomes.untestable:noTraffic: E3, realm = true and pc = true, but no E1

positiveControlK4.consequence: a path that is not 'testable' leaves C7 coverage for that path open; X8 stays PENDING for C7 (the K4 rule of 0.23 applied per path)

zeroCriteria.rule:
zero canary events in X8C7--

for every path P and silent gaps; any event is FAIL (in K0 a release blocker: governance withdraws the extension)
zeroCriteria.validity: a zero for path P counts only if the K4 control of P is 'testable' in the same run; otherwise the cell is reported 'zero not meaningful' and C7 stays PENDING

informationalK3.rule: reach expected per path (Rtc off); absence is 'unexplained', never success

evidenceSchema.canaryEvent: 0.23 canaryEvent with C = 'C7' and an added field path in {P1..P5}

notResolvedHere: whether an untestable document.write path is acceptable for the gate (PB6) is a source decision
